t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Kellie Pickler comes to a rehearsal to share her experience and motivate the girls as Training Camp is coming to an end. Melissa Rycroft makes Kelsey aware of a big mistake.  Candace Romo helps with a big night of cuts.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Squad announcement is bittersweet as some favorites go home.  The team has their first appearance at the Star Ribbon cutting.  Game Day is when dreams come true!

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Hundreds of beautiful and talented women converge on AT&T Stadium to start the hardest audition process in professional sports, trying out for a coveted spot on the most famous NFL cheerleading squad in the world, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: With the field narrowed down to 119 women, the pressure is on.  They must quickly learn a power pom routine and the famous kickline in order to perform it an hour later before the judges.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: The veterans finally enter the audition process. Now all 83 women are judged head to head during a panel interview, a solo dance performance and on their appearance on the football field as seen and the big screen.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: 44 women begin the very first training camp at the new 1 billion dollar Cowboys' facility, The Star.  At the First Meeting, Kelli lays down the law and makes it clear that eight women will be sent home this summer.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: First, the ladies need to have the "classic look" of a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Kelli's hair and make-up transformations are legendary.  The ladies are also assessed through a new state of the art fitness test, "Styku".

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Kelli media trains the rookie candidates to determine who best represents the DCC at press events.  NBC news anchor, Meredith Land tests their on-camera interview skills.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Personality is critical when representing the DCC brand.  Kelli takes the women on location to see how they interact during a public appearance.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Katy Perry's choreographer, Nick Florez, stops by to offer some performance advice to the ladies.  A day that each cheerleader never forgets.  The first time they wear the DCC uniform to pose for their cameo photos.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: The squad goes on an appearance to support pop music star, Demi Lovato. The ladies learn the entrance to the famed pre-game dance.  It's a make or break moment.  If a woman can't learn it quickly it might be her last night.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: With two suspended vets, the team must re-block their formations for their Hall Of Fame performance.   New vets step up as a new point of the triangle is named.  The rookie candidates try to get their footing during this never seen before rehearsal.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: 23 veterans travel to Canton, Ohio to perform at Jerry Jones' induction to the Pro Football Hall of Fame.  All eyes are watching as the DCC perform for the NFL elite.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: As training camp winds down the pressure skyrockets.  No one wants to be sent home now.  The ladies start to crack under the pressure.  Another one is sent home.  Will this be the final cut?

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: Kelli announces the official squad and the women realize the hard-fought dream of becoming a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Full of excitement and nerves, the squad prepares for their very first football game at AT&T Stadium.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
st: The Road to World Class Begins
d: Hundreds of eager hopefuls -- ranging from starry-eyed rookies to experienced NFL cheerleaders -- gather at AT&T Stadium for a shot at joining the world's most famous squad.

t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
d: The 125 remaining hopefuls must nail a choreographed routine before advancing to the final rounds, and the DCC veterans reveal their plans for the future.
